title: Masayoshi Son's Portfolio Concentration on Intel Sparks Market Movement
description: Recent filings show Masayoshi Son's firm allocated a significant portion of its U.S. holdings to Intel, impacting chip stock prices.

sources.title: Billionaire Masayoshi Son Put 66% of Its $18 Billion US Portfolio Into 1 Stock
Intel and AMD Fall 4% as 13F Filings Reveal Concentrated Chip Bets
SoftBank put two-thirds of its U.S. stock portfolio into Intel, SEC filing shows

sections.heading: Investment Allocation
paragraphs: According to Yahoo Finance, billionaire Masayoshi Son put 66% of an $18 billion U.S. portfolio into one stock. Quartz reports that SoftBank placed two-thirds of its U.S. stock portfolio into Intel, as shown by an SEC filing.

sections.heading: Market Reaction
paragraphs: Following the release of 13F filings, Intel and AMD fell 4%, according to 24/7 Wall St. The filings revealed concentrated chip bets within the market.

sections.heading: Source of Information
paragraphs: The details regarding the portfolio allocation were derived from SEC filings and 13F filings, as reported by Quartz and 24/7 Wall St.

faq.q: What percentage of the U.S. portfolio was invested in a single stock?
faq.a: Yahoo Finance reports that 66% of the $18 billion U.S. portfolio was put into one stock.

faq.q: Which company was the primary focus of the investment?
faq.a: According to Quartz, SoftBank put two-thirds of its U.S. stock portfolio into Intel.

faq.q: How did chip stocks react to the filings?
faq.a: 24/7 Wall St. states that Intel and AMD fell 4% as 13F filings revealed concentrated chip bets.
